title: Claim / Assertion
description: A statement made by a party or inferred by a model. A claim is never automatically a fact. Its status must be explicit and starts unverified.

asserted_by_role.description: The role of whoever made the claim (e.g. 'employee', 'manager', 'hr'), not a personal identifier.

status.description: A claim may only become 'corroborated' through an explicit human decision or independent evidence, never through model output alone.

corroborated_by_decision_id.description: Set only when status is 'corroborated'; must reference a human_decision.
